handoff.text:
Rejected (agent-e0a3, W9 reviewer r3) on the logo only; everything else stays. RULING: the logo must keep its own face. PLAN '## Request' item 5: interface font for 'everything besides the logo'; PLAN C3 step 7: '.brand is unchanged'. Today .brand follows the chosen font: src/styles.css:1496-1497 is '.brand { font-family: inherit; ...}' (pre-existing; harmless before wave 9 because :root was the Futura stack, wrong now that --ui-font changes). The spec at tests/w9-fonts.spec.ts:189-196 pins that wrong behaviour (brand == parent font). Other points ACCEPTED: the four helper exceptions are narrow ([aria-label='Font family'] .dropdown-value shows the document font; .footnote-number/.footnote-body are only in src/editor/FootnoteArea.tsx, the notes printed under the page = document text, which the plan's 'document text' exception covers; .dropdown-option skipped only while the font menu is open, because each option previews its face; Popover data-state='closing' is a menu leaving the screen). Fresh runs: PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1440 npx playwright test tests/w9-fonts.spec.ts tests/appearance.spec.ts --output test-results/T266-review -> 22/22; npx vitest run src/fonts -> 24/24; npx tsc -b exit 0.
WORK ORDER:
(1) python3 team/team.py files add T266 --agent <ID> src/styles.css (unowned now). If it exits 2, stop and say so in the done note.
(2) src/styles.css line 1497, inside the '.brand {' rule that starts at line 1496 (the one with font-size: var(--type-title)): replace 'font-family: inherit;' with 'font-family: Futura, "Avenir Next", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;' (the old default stack, so the logo looks exactly as before). Use the Edit tool; change nothing else in that file.
(3) tests/w9-fonts.spec.ts:189-196: replace the brandInherits block and its comment with an assertion that, with Georgia chosen, getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.brand')).fontFamily (quotes stripped) starts with 'Futura', and keep the comment 'the brand keeps its own face (PLAN C3 step 7)'. Also assert the brand's parent computes to Georgia, so the check proves the brand differs from its surroundings.
(4) Add one plain-dropdown scan: on the Projects page (after the existing expectUiFont at :188) click the 'Sort projects' button, wait for role option 'Name' visible, call expectUiFont(page, 'open Sort dropdown') with no font-menu flag, press Escape. (The plan's 'an open dropdown' is otherwise only checked with every option exempt.)
(5) Fail-first: before step 2, run the spec once with steps 3-4 in place; the brand assertion must fail (it receives Georgia). Save that output to docs/agent-work/2026-11-10-ui-wave-9/notes/C3-fail-first-r3.txt.
Proof: PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1440 npx playwright test tests/w9-fonts.spec.ts tests/appearance.spec.ts tests/projects-screen.spec.ts --output test-results/T266 (serial lock) -> all pass (projects-screen checks the brand's position); npx tsc -b clean. Update notes/C3.md: remove the brand deviation, add the r3 evidence.
